nodes.speaker: Nin
nodes.text: Nabu-la! Where are you running off to? Surely to help with preparations for the Namdamgal Festival!

choices.text: er...yes! That is exactly it! I want to help with whatever was making those crazy clack noises...
Not everything revolves around your anniversary Nin. But sure I'll stop what I'm doing anyway. Those clangs must've been from all the activity here.

nodes.speaker: Nin
nodes.text: HA! And it's a damn shame, isn't it? Thank you for doing your part to keep my dreams alive. Please bring these charming sandwiches to the daycare for me, and make sure Gilgrokmesh is fairly distributing them because Gizzal has been coming home ravenous despite insisting she's had snack and Garza just shrugs when I ask.

choices.text: That IS weird, those two are inseparable but then again...I'll see what I can learn!

nodes.speaker: Nin
nodes.text: Eh? Clacki...Oh! You must mean the stunning booms from the exotic drums Lunamkita has brought back from his recent trades excursions. He's brought all manner of strange and mystifying musical instruments this time - he was actually looking for you earlier.

choices.text: Hmm, yeah that's probably what I'm thinking of...anyway! What CAN I help with?

nodes.speaker: Nin
nodes.text: Oh, and Lunamkita's back and was looking for you - luckily the daycare is close to his caravan!

choices.text: Ah! Thanks Nin!

nodes.speaker: Nin
nodes.text: Would you mind please bring these charming sandwiches to the daycare for me on your way to see him and make sure Gilgrokmesh is fairly distributing them because Gizzal has been coming home ravenous despite insisting she's had snack and Garza just shrugs when I ask. Luckily Lunamkita's caravan is close to the daycare!

choices.text: Yes, yes. I'll see what I can find out!

nodes.speaker: Zibatum
nodes.text: Ah, Nabu! Come smell this spice, isn't it simply intoxicating?

choices.text: But will it intoxicate me?
Wow I didn't know mother earth made such noxious smells...

nodes.speaker: Zibatum
nodes.text: Eh? Oh! Not this, though the main note comes from a plant related to your beloved Cannabud Flower.

choices.text: Consider me cooked, Zibatum. Speaking of, what's boiling here?

nodes.speaker: Zibatum
nodes.text: I think you mean yourself- and it's pronounced OBnoxious...

choices.text: Yikes, my bad. It's er...very medicinal smelling. Anyway what's cooking?

nodes.speaker: Zibatum
nodes.text: Oh, just boiling fish guts and heads for my daughter's new friend - a fox we've named Amet. Urgalkua found it orphaned in the reeds last week and Didila fell in love instantly.

choices.text: Fish heads, fish heads Roly-poly fish heads Fish heads, fish heads Eat them up, yum!

nodes.speaker: Zibatum
nodes.text: In the morning, laughing, happy fish heads In the evening, floating in the soup! Hahaha...well I'm just about finished here. Would you mind helping me carry them home? I'll make it worth your time!

choices.text: Er...I'm kind of busy with these abominative finger sandwiches...
Anything to not be alone with this...snack...platter...

nodes.speaker: Zibatum
nodes.text: Yikes, those are something...maybe the fish heads will evoke less terror and yet! Alas! Not done boiling. Are they for the daycare? Didila can er...escort you the rest of the way. We kept her home as I mentioned. I'm sure Ningirila won't mind watching the fire for a while. We'll just make sure first.

choices.text: Can't we just go? I'm already in a hurry...
Eat em up- yum!
er...eat em up...yum...!

nodes.speaker: Gilgrokmesh
nodes.text: Listen up, Nabu. While you're out here being a woke beta and befriending hyenas, I'm escaping the Cave-Matrix! Behold, the Alpha Spear! Top tier merch. You need this if you want high-value gatherer status.

choices.text: Wow, Gilgrokmesh! I've never seen a stick with a rock tied so... loosely to it! Simply incredible.
That looks like you chewed on a branch and stuck a pebble to it with mud, you absolute clown.
[Stare blankly at him and his sad stick]

nodes.speaker: Gilgrokmesh
nodes.text: Exactly! Only a true High-Value Hunter understands such peak craftsmanship. I'll let you hold onto this prototype so you can manifest my grindset. Catch you later, brokey!

choices.text: [Pick up the shoddy spear as he struts away]

nodes.speaker: Gilgrokmesh
nodes.text: You're just intimidated by my overwhelming masculine aura! Whatever, keep the spear, maybe it'll cure your woke mindset! I'm off to do cave-pushups.

choices.text: [Pick up the shoddy spear as he struts away]

nodes.speaker: Gilgrokmesh
nodes.text: Too stunned to speak? Classic female reaction to pure apex dominance. I'll leave this here so you can admire it. Don't touch it with your unwashed hyena hands! I'm out!

choices.text: [Pick up the shoddy spear as he struts away]

inventoryItems.name: Basket of Dates
inventoryItems.description: Phoenix Dactylifera ; a combination of the Greek word dactylus, or “finger,” and the Latin word ferous, or “bearing.”

inventoryItems.name: Basket of Figs.
inventoryItems.description: The word sycophancy derives from the Ancient Greek sukophantēs, literally meaning 'fig-revealer', combining sukon (fig) and phainein (to show).

inventoryItems.name: Foraging Basket
inventoryItems.description: Pockets haven't been invented yet...allegedly!

inventoryItems.name: Brimstone Shell
inventoryItems.description: bivalve shell split in half and held together by a leather hinge. One side is lined with a rough strike-plate made of rough volcanic basalt. Inside the shell rest a dozen thick splints of resinous pine dipped in yellow sulfur.

inventoryItems.name: Ordinary Cucumber...
inventoryItems.description: Nothing to see here at all. Just a typical Cucumis Sativus. Which further drives the point home. Cucumis means nothing more and nothing less than cucumber.

inventoryItems.name: Grazing Cowcumber
inventoryItems.description: Nothing to see here, simply a standard boiler-plate cowcumber grazing in the fields...

inventoryItems.name: Tense Cucumber
inventoryItems.description: Why do I get the feeling this cucumber has me on target-lock...? No sudden movements!

inventoryItems.name: Sleeping Cowcumber
inventoryItems.description: Shhh, the cowcumber slumbers. lmao let's tip it! surely nothing will bite us in the ass!

inventoryItems.name: Deep Sea Fried Mozzarella Sticky Cowcumber
inventoryItems.description: Waiter, there's proprioceptive goo oozing from my cowcumber. And I won't pipe down about it until everyone gets a round on me!

inventoryItems.name: Cave Berries
inventoryItems.description: these berries grow with very little sunlight in odd little shrubs outside the mouths of rock craggles and caves

inventoryItems.name: INAPPROPRIATE SEA CUCUMBER
inventoryItems.description: Take this bull to the studfarm, there's children in this game!

inventoryItems.name: Nabu's Hand-Sickle
inventoryItems.description: Handmade and always sharp, Nabu -mostly- uses it for harvesting...-mostly-

inventoryItems.name: Raw Beeswax
inventoryItems.description: Mind your own! >;(

inventoryItems.name: Gilgrokmesh's Shoddy Spear
inventoryItems.description: Premium merch, subscribe for the hookup!

inventoryItems.name: Basil
inventoryItems.description: Evil cannot go where basil grows.

inventoryItems.name: Mysterious Broken Flute
inventoryItems.description: Lu-Namkita the trader gave it to you because it doesn't (seem) to work...I wonder what kind of bone it is!

inventoryItems.description: Flint, much unlike the city, is nurtured by prisitine, chemically stable water formed in ancient seafloors.  Close behind diamond, it's among the toughest lithics; proving that the hardest mfuckers outchea tend to be the most fragile of foo's on da block. Petition to rename it gilgRockmesh.

inventoryItems.description: Widdershins go when Moon doth wane, And the werewolves howl by the dread wolfsbane.

loreEntries.title: Clan Musings #1
loreEntries.content: Nin is -almost- impossible to offend and if she weren't so smiley and sweet I'd call her a straight up bruiser.

loreEntries.title: The Namdamgal Festival
loreEntries.content: A weeklong celebration and feast commemorating the marriage of a clan's chieftain/ess'. Endless food, music, brews and all other sorts of bawdy shenaigans. It does not have a fixed day on a calendar, rather it varies to suit respective couple's chosen marriage date.

characters.name: Penzer
characters.description: Oldest boy in the village, his skepticism is only matched by his disdain for all things Gilgrokmesh.

characters.name: Henbur
characters.description: Oldest girl in the village. Maddeningly shy, she can't help but catch everyone's eye for her skill at the loom.

characters.name: Amaedina
characters.description: The village farmer and Lusilaĝa's sister.

characters.name: Ninĝirila
characters.description: The village butcher and Urgalkua's sister. She doesn't need that cleaver to command respect from the community but damn it sure helps don't it?

characters.name: Nin
characters.description: The chieftain's wife who he loving refers to as his R'n'R - Radiance and Resplendence. She herself would say 'Raucous'n'Rowdy." Maybe the truth is somewhere in between...

characters.name: En
characters.description: The village Chieftain and Nin's devoted husband which may seem paradoxical since His brow is ever furrowed and laconic in affect yet somehow one can't help but see and feel seen by the twinkle in his belying eyes.

characters.name: Urgalkua
characters.description: The village fisherman. He's always slightly damp but thanks to his wife Zibatum's herbal aromatics he never smells like the fishguts he feeds his daughter Didila's pet fox.

characters.name: Inimdub
characters.description: The village scribe and Nabu's friend. He's always got the tea AND the tablets to back it up.

characters.name: Abbasen
characters.description: En's dad and retired military campaign colonel. En's only seen him smile once and that was when Amarakne offered him a sweater one unnaturally chilly summer eve.

characters.name: Amarakne
characters.description: Nin's mother and the village weaver extraordinaire. Don't let her creepy bony fingers fool ya, she's nimble AND spry. To date, Henbur has been the only student dedicated enough to ignore the bony creepy spider fingers...

characters.name: Zibatum
characters.description: The village herbalist and gardener. She always smells of patchouli and lavender. She's Didila's mom and Urgalkua's

characters.name: Ereshurud
characters.description: By personally smelting raw ore herself, Ereshurud has secured her title as Superior Copper Merchant, and as a part of her 100% satisfaction guarantee, she promises to never treat you nor your messenger with contempt. And if you are a victim of Ea-Nasir, just bring your receipt and she will resmelt the botched order for 50% off!

characters.name: Lusilaĝa
characters.description: The farmers brother and the village baker.

characters.name: Amet
characters.description: Didila's best friend. Likes: fish heads fish heads roly poly fish heads. Dislikes: vegitabel. >:(

characters.name: Burgul
characters.description: Village stonesmith. Married to Kilili. No one knows how he pulled that. Hesphaistos type-beat.

characters.name: Urnanše
characters.description: The clan healer and medicine man. Zibatum and he are always comparing notes about this or that baneful poison. Unnerving sense of humor. Catch phrase: "Hi, Everybody!"; will bill insurance if response isn't "Hi Dr. Urnanše!"

characters.name: Kilili
characters.description: Oh, Kilili! She's on tonight! You know her hips don't lie And she's starting to feel it's right All the attraction, the tension Don't you see, baby? This is perfection!

characters.name: Enbalag
characters.description: Got his start at the bottom tapping various livestock to their chagrin, Enbalag made a name for himself at the birth of an alleged baby savior under the handle "Lil Drumma Boi" but much like child he played for, it was relegation to the one hit wonders of history.

characters.name: Dugšura
characters.description: The potter man. Also the potman. Coincidentally, Dugšura loves getting high while shaping clay and has his own mini-garden near the reeds where he gets his clay despite his wife Amaraedina clucking about how rivers and crops are associates not friends.

characters.name: Timaruru
characters.description: The she-lion of the steppe, Timaruru is the lead hunter and always brings home the mega-faunic bacon. Gilgrokmesh swears he hates her but we all know who that shoddy spear was REALLY for...

characters.name: Ğešnağar
characters.description: How much wood could a woodchuck chuck if a woodchuck could chuck wood? Not nearly enough if you ask Ğešnağar the clan's queen carpenter and beaver critic.

characters.name: Šagada
characters.description: Amaedina and Dugšura's middle child. She's abhors anything related to crops and clay and is known to sabotage chore-time at all costs.

characters.name: Lugida
characters.description: Ereshurud's son. Prone to panic attacks, Lugida prefers expressing himself through melody on his reed flute.

characters.name: Inuntur
characters.description: Amaedina and Dugšura's youngest daughter with a napoleon complex and a nasty habit of lording it over Dagrim.

characters.name: Nagugsi
characters.description: Kilili's younger sister. Much too serious for anyone's good you can find her anywhere children groaning from another dose of "Well, actually..."

characters.name: Biluda
characters.description: The eldest daughter of Amaedina and Dugšura. If she's not careful, mother earth will swallow her up as fertilizer for all the time she spends digging in the dirt.

characters.name: Dagrim
characters.description: Baby Dagrim, Nin and En's youngest. Even though he can't speak, one gets a sense of skeptical ire from his googoos and gagas.
